question: Folk songs in _________ are called Raganis.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryana**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Raganis** are a form of folk songs native to the state of **Haryana**.
 
• These songs are an integral part of Haryanvi culture and are typically performed during various local festivals and celebrations.
